checks.explanation: Zipline has continued rapidly accelerating its launch cadence, expanding into new cities and states (Houston, Phoenix, Austin, Cleveland and more) roughly weekly since 2026, backed by a $600M raise aimed at reaching at least four new states by year's end.

sources.title: Zipline charts drone delivery expansion with $600M in new funding

checks.explanation: Zipline has added numerous major brand partners since, including Walmart, Sweetgreen, Panera, GNC, Little Caesars, Chipotle, and a major long-term partnership with Uber Eats.

sources.title: Uber adds Zipline drones to its Eats delivery network

checks.explanation: No independent data source confirms whether US instant deliveries have reached anywhere near a 50-billion-per-year run rate; even Uber and Zipline's own ambitious joint target is only 1 million deliveries per day (~365M/year) by 2029.

sources.title: Uber and Zipline target one million Uber Eats drone deliveries per day

checks.explanation: Zipline itself has reached a $7.6B valuation with strong growth, but the 5-10 year window for a multi-hundred-billion-dollar automated logistics company hasn't elapsed.
